name: Claim
description: Claim your name on any media you've already made - image, PDF, video or audio. Stamp your author, copyright and licence as Content Credentials (a durable raster Imprint too), preserving any credential already inside the file - all on your device, before you upload it anywhere.

inputs.label: Your files
inputs.help: Drop the finished work you want to claim - photos, a PDF, an MP4, an audio clip. Each file is stamped on your device and handed back; nothing is uploaded. Drop several to stamp them all at once.

inputs.label: Artist / author
inputs.help: Your name - embedded as the file's author/creator (dc:creator in the Content Credential; EXIF Artist / XMP where the format carries it).

inputs.label: Copyright notice
inputs.help: The © line written into the file, e.g. © 2026 Your Name. Left blank, no copyright is asserted.

inputs.label: Rights / licence
inputs.help: How others may use your work. Proprietary keeps every right; the Creative Commons options grant specific permissions and embed a link to the licence deed.

options.label: Public Domain Mark - already in the public domain

inputs.label: Contact
inputs.help: Optional - how to reach you for licensing (email or site), embedded alongside the author.

inputs.label: Title / description
inputs.help: Optional - a short title or description of the work.

inputs.label: Add a durable invisible watermark
inputs.help: Raster images only (JPEG/PNG/WebP). Embeds an imperceptible neural watermark that survives screenshotting and re-encoding - what strips the Content Credential. Ignored for PDF, video and audio.
